regime_context: The absolute-trend gate is positive for a broad majority of Canadian themes. Base Metals & Copper leads in momentum rank with full breadth, while Gold Miners shows persistent trend characteristics. No single narrative dominates; the rotation is wide. Momentum ranks are a focus lens, not a return forecast — the only validated edge is drawdown/shake-out avoidance via the gate, which is currently on for eligible themes.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (XGD.TO) is a close challenger with strong durability (0.79) and a trend tag; watch for XGD.TO outperforming XBM.TO by more than 2% over any rolling 10-day window as a signal that leadership may be rotating to gold miners.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Trend-gate eligibility and extreme breadth (1.0) signal widespread participation in the theme's uptrend. While momentum rank offers no forward edge, the combination of a positive trend gate, no crowding, and moderate durability reduces immediate reversal risk; the lean is a tactical trend-following expression, not a return forecast.
evidence: momentum rank #1 as focus lens, not alpha
theses.dissent: Base metals are highly cyclical; a China slowdown, global recession fears, or disappointing stimulus could cause sharp underperformance even if the absolute trend held until now.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO total return trails the S&P/TSX Composite total return by 3% or more over the next 20 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
